newsitem.title: CHINA: South China tyre factory declared bankrupt.
newsitem.headline: South China tyre factory declared bankrupt.

text.p: The Haikou Tyre Factory in southern China's Hainan province has been declared bankrupt, said an edition of the Hainan Daily seen in Beijing on Sunday.
The state-owned factory, listed as one of China's 50 largest firms in the rubber industry, had debts totalling 256 million yuan at the end of August, the newspaper said.
A Chinese rubber industry group was planning to purchase the ailing factory, the newspaper said without elaborating.
The factory had employed nearly 2,300 workers and had sourced its rubber from suppliers in Hainan, one of China's main rubber producing regions, it said.
The factory had made mostly automobile tyres, it said. It gave no further details.

About 70 percent of China's state-owned companies are estimated to be opereating at a loss but Beijing has been reluctant to push ahead with bankruptcies for fear that mass unemployment and loss of cradle-to-grave welfare could spark social unrest.
